summary.text: Marty Flynn is a Democratic state senator from Scranton who took office as Pennsylvania Senate District 22's senator in June 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A former professional boxer, he previously served in the state House for more than eight years.

paragraphs.text: Marty Flynn was born and raised in Scranton, graduated from Scranton Preparatory School in 1994, and earned a bachelor's degree in Legal Studies from Marywood University, according to his official biography.

He began boxing at Marywood and had a decade-long professional career before working as the Inmate Education and Program Coordinator at Lackawanna County Prison, where he also chaired the Prison Misconduct Board.
Flynn was elected to the 113th District of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives in 2013 and held the seat for more than eight years.
He was sworn in as senator for the 22nd Senatorial District on June 9, 2021.

His official biography, last updated January 2023, lists him as a member of the Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, Labor and Industry, and Law and Justice committees and as Democratic chair of the Transportation Committee.
